messages:
Priya: Quick sync request 1: we need a compact observability sample for marketplace + HW SI onboarding. Keep it small, scrubbed, and plug-and-play.
Ben: Agreed. Requirements we discussed: OTLP payloads, metrics for GPU/cpu/mem, short trace spans, and a dashboard mapping doc.
Marco: For SI demos we need GPU metadata: gpu.vendor, gpu.model, gpu.memory_gb, pci_bus_id (obfuscated). Also a perf flag `burst=true` for the high-QPS sample.
Kai: Add: OTel semantic version (>=1.14), resource attributes (service.name, service.instance.id), and a `redwood.stack_version` tag.
Lina (Datadog): From Datadog side: include `dd.env` and `dd.service_version` attributes. If you add `dd.trace_url_template` we can pre-wire the preview links.
Priya: Draft sample manifest (sharing inline):
```json
{
  "manifest_version": "1.0",
  "services": ["inference-proxy","model-frontend","kv-cache"],
  "span_count": 4200,
  "metrics_count": 1800,
  "logs_count": 900,
  "sensitive_policy": "mask: user_id,session_id,serials",
  "notes": "includes optional high-qps burst file"
}
```
Ben: Good. Couple of asks: 1) provide a README with an OTLP collector config snippet that routes to both Datadog and local collector. 2) add a simple python replay tool: `replay/send_samples.py` that reads ndjson and pushes OTLP.
Marco: We'll generate two bundles: `sample-normal.tar.gz` and `sample-burst.tar.gz` (burst has 10x span rate). Both will have a `dashboards/queries.md` with recommended Datadog queries.
Kai: For metrics queries, example to include: `avg:gpu.utilization{service:inference-proxy}.rollup(avg,60)`. For traces: provide `trace_id` linking pattern and a sample `resource.attributes` mapping.
Lina (Datadog): We'll prepare a dashboard template and a tile list. Also request: include `trace.sample_rate` attribute in spans so we can demo different sampling settings.
Priya: CI/Validation: include a lightweight smoke test `smoke/check_bundle.sh` that validates schema, runs replay against local collector, and confirms spans and metrics received.
Ben: Security: ensure all vendor logos removed, hardware serials hashed, and no real customer IDs. Mark bundle internal until legal ok for public.
Marco: Action items: Marco -> produce burst bundle, Kai -> add collector config + replay script, Priya -> manifest + README, Lina -> dashboard template and queries. Target: 7 days.
TraceBot: automated: uploaded draft bundle `obs-sample-v1.tar.gz` to drive at https://rwd.co/obs-samples/v1 (internal).
Priya: Small extra: include an example flamegraph svg (lightweight) and a trace waterfall PNG for marketplace preview. Keep sizes under 200KB each.
Lina (Datadog): We'll include an embeddable flamegraph widget link for the listing. Also leaving a note: if you want interactive trace waterfall in the marketplace tile, send the json trace link pattern.
Kai: One more technical note: document recommended collector resource limits for the demo (cpu: 0.25, mem: 256Mi) and a truncation policy for large logs.
Ben: Ok, I'll raise the PR `partner-observability-samples` with the draft artifacts. Drop the PR link here when ready.
Priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-observability-samples/pull/22 - includes manifest, samples, replay script, collector config, and dashboards/queries.md.
Lina (Datadog): Reviewing PR now. Quick ask: add `examples/requests/curl.sh` calling the Redwood host mock that emits spans so integrators can see end-to-end with minimal setup.
Priya: Adding curl + node + python examples to `examples/` folder.
Marco: Note to SIs: hardware serials obfuscated as `HW-XXXX-<hash>`. Add comment in README.
Ben: Legal/regulatory check scheduled for tomorrow. Keep bundle internal until approval.
Priya: Thanks team. Follow-ups: (1) Merge PR after fixes (Priya), (2) Lina to drop dashboard template (Datadog), (3) Marco to upload burst bundle. Target close: next Friday. :thumbsup:
Lina (Datadog): Will deliver dashboard template + reviewer notes by tomorrow EOD.
TraceBot: reminder set for 6 days before the target close.
